privacy.title: Your baby’s room does not have to move to the cloud.
privacy.body: MiuCam’s core monitoring flow works between your two paired devices on the same reachable local network. In normal use, camera and microphone media is not relayed through a MiuCam cloud server.
privacy.noTracking: No account, ads, or analytics SDK by default

privacy.noInternet: Core monitoring does not require internet access
privacy.securityBody: Local media transfer currently uses HTTP/WebSocket; MiuCam does not claim TLS or end-to-end encryption. Use MiuCam only on a trusted Wi-Fi network with controlled access.
privacy.localRoute: The data path stays within your home network

faq.title: Good to know.
faq.subtitle: Understand what MiuCam does—and its limits—before you set it up.
faq.internetQ: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.internetA: No. For core monitoring, both devices only need to be able to reach each other on the same local Wi-Fi network. Initial setup, updates, or optional store transactions may require internet access.
faq.remoteQ: Can I monitor from outside my home over the internet?
faq.remoteA: No. MiuCam is currently designed for devices on the same reachable local network; it is not a ‘monitor from anywhere’ product.
faq.closedQ: Will I receive alerts when the app is fully closed?
faq.closedA: MiuCam delivers events over a live local connection; it does not use Apple Push Notification service (APNs) or Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM). Alert delivery is not guaranteed when the parent app or local connection is unreachable.
faq.iosQ: Does the iPhone nursery camera work in the background?
faq.iosA: Because of iOS restrictions, the nursery camera works while MiuCam is in the foreground. Android may offer more flexibility as a long-running nursery device.
faq.encryptionA: No. Pairing is protected by an access key, but local HTTP/WebSocket transfer currently provides neither TLS nor end-to-end encryption. Use it only on a Wi-Fi network you trust and control.
faq.medicalQ: Is MiuCam a medical monitoring device?
faq.medicalA: No. MiuCam is not a substitute for adult supervision, medical devices, or emergency services. Alerts are supporting signals, not diagnoses.

privacyPage.title: Draft privacy notice
privacyPage.subtitle: We clearly explain what data is processed, why it is needed, where it stays, and which controls are yours.
privacyPage.draftBody: This notice describes the current technical behavior, but remains a pre-release draft. It is not a final privacy notice until the data controller/developer identity and a dedicated contact channel have been added.
privacyPage.intro: MiuCam is a camera and audio monitoring app that works between a nursery device and a parent device over the same reachable local network. By default, it uses no account, advertising, analytics SDK, or MiuCam cloud media relay.
privacyPage.overviewP1: This notice covers the data processed by the core monitoring features of the MiuCam mobile app. The device in the nursery role processes camera and microphone data; the paired parent device displays that stream over the same local network and manages room controls.
privacyPage.overviewP2: MiuCam follows a local-network-first model: its core media stream requires neither a MiuCam account nor an internet-hosted media server.
privacyPage.cameraItem1: Camera video and microphone audio are processed on the nursery device for live streaming and local analysis of cry-like sounds, loud noise, motion, and light changes.
privacyPage.cameraItem2: Live video, audio, control messages, and alerts are sent only to devices paired by the user and reachable on the local network.
privacyPage.deviceDataItem2: Event and notification history shown in the app.
privacyPage.deviceDataItem3: Access-key information used to authenticate the connection.
privacyPage.keysBody: Access keys on the parent device are stored in the operating system’s secure key store. The nursery device stores a verification hash instead of the raw access key.
privacyPage.networkBody: MiuCam sends media and control traffic between two paired devices over local HTTP and WebSocket connections. The connection is authenticated with an access key generated during pairing.
privacyPage.networkWarningBody: The current local transfer does not provide TLS or end-to-end encryption. MiuCam should be used only on a trusted, access-controlled Wi-Fi network protected by a strong password. Open or public networks are not suitable.
privacyPage.thirdPartiesP1: MiuCam’s core monitoring feature works without an internet connection. The default product flow contains no advertising or user-behavior analytics SDK, and no camera or microphone media is sent to a cloud server operated by MiuCam.
privacyPage.thirdPartiesP2: If optional in-app purchases are enabled, Apple App Store or Google Play payment infrastructure may be used. Purchase-verification data may be sent only to a configured, trusted HTTPS verification service; camera and microphone media is never sent to that service. Those services are governed by their own privacy terms.
privacyPage.storageItem1: When pairings are removed in the app, the associated secure access keys are also deleted.
privacyPage.storageItem2: Event and notification history can be cleared in the app.
privacyPage.storageItem3: Secure access keys are not configured to be included in device backups or transferred to another device.
privacyPage.storageItem4: If iOS retains Keychain records after the app is uninstalled, MiuCam removes records from the previous installation the first time a clean installation is opened.
privacyPage.storageBody: When the app is uninstalled, local data managed as application data by the operating system is also deleted in accordance with the platform’s rules.
privacyPage.permissionsIntro: MiuCam requests the following permissions only for the relevant feature:
privacyPage.permissionCamera: Camera: capture the nursery video and scan QR codes.
privacyPage.permissionMic: Microphone: transmit room audio and push-to-talk audio.
privacyPage.permissionNetwork: Local network: discover and connect the two devices.
privacyPage.permissionNotification: Notifications: display event alerts on the connected parent device.
privacyPage.permissionService: Android foreground service: maintain a supported nursery-role session in accordance with operating-system requirements.
privacyPage.permissionsBody: Permissions can be withdrawn in the operating-system settings. Features that depend on a withdrawn permission will stop working.
privacyPage.safetyBody: MiuCam is not a substitute for adult supervision, medical devices, or emergency services. Sound and motion alerts are supporting signals, not diagnoses or safety guarantees. The user is responsible for placing the device safely, keeping cables out of the child’s reach, and providing appropriate supervision.
